instruction: Primary Structural Frame Use the opened Bonsai IFC authoring environment to create a new metric IFC4 primary structural frame from a blank model. Save the completed model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. The model must contain one project, one site, one building, and one storey named Level 00. Include four IfcColumn entities, four IfcBeam entities, one IfcSlab, one IfcStructuralAnalysisModel, and one IfcRelAssignsToGroup relationship. Do not include spaces, walls, doors, windows, proxies, furniture, roofs, stairs, or flow terminals, and keep every IfcRoot GlobalId unique. Name the structural analysis model Primary Frame and assign exactly C1, C2, C3, C4, B1, B2, B3, and B4 to it. Place the column centers at C1 = (0.00 m, 0.00 m), C2 = (6.00 m, 0.00 m), C3 = (6.00 m, 4.00 m), and C4 = (0.00 m, 4.00 m). Each column must be 0.30 m by 0.30 m by 3.60 m. Name the beams B1, B2, B3, and B4; B1 and B2 must be 6.00 m by 0.30 m by 0.45 m, while B3 and B4 must be 0.30 m by 4.00 m by 0.45 m. Name the slab Deck Slab and make it 6.00 m by 4.00 m by 0.18 m. Assign all columns, beams, and the slab to Level 00. Other representation details may vary. [Software] Bonsai workflows are used together with Blender; start Blender with `blender` (adjust path if needed).
